Check the organization's accounting setup (preferences, fiscal periods, chart of accounts) for any finance reader without showing administration settings; each failed check is named in findings and the others go on.

Start or change the organization's accounting setup run. An organization with no accounting preference of its own is set up from a chart template (init#PartyAccountingConfiguration with sourcePartyId, the base currency, fiscal year start and costing basis, and the posting guard and single-currency documents on); for one with its own preference a changed basis goes through store#Preferences. The fiscal periods of the opening day are made when missing. The opening balances are replaced (balances, or balancesCsvText with the headers account, debit and credit) or one line is saved (balanceLine; empty amounts remove it). Each change raises runVersion. Refuses a user without finance administration, a source that is not a chart template, a stale runVersion, an activated run, a new opening day or migration account once open items are imported, a migration or line account that is not an active posting account of the organization, a line of the migration account, a line with both a debit and a credit, and an account on two lines.

parameter.description: The chart template, for an organization not set up yet.

parameter.description: The cutover day (yyyy-MM-dd): the opening balances and open items post on it.

parameter.description: Defaults to the organization's GatMigrationClearing account.

service.description: The organization's setup run for review: its basis, the chart templates, the opening balance lines with their totals, each receivable and payable control account's balance against what the open items posted to it, and a page of the open items with each side's count and total. Changes nothing. Refuses a user without finance administration.

Import the open customer invoices and supplier bills at cutover, from rows or a CSV text or file with the headers direction (receivable or payable), partyId, documentNumber, documentDate, dueDate and openAmount, and optionally currencyUomId and description. Each row goes through create#OpenItem in its own transaction: a refused row is named with its reason and the others are kept; a row imported before answers its invoice, so importing again makes nothing twice. With verifyOnly the rows are checked and nothing is made. Refuses a user without finance administration, a file without the headers and more than 5,000 rows.

One open customer invoice or supplier bill at cutover, for import#OpenItems: a real invoice with the opening flag (openingSetupRunId), dated at its document date, due at its own due date, booked on the opening day, with one line of its open amount on the migration clearing account; it is finalized (an invoice) or approved (a bill) through update#Invoice, so its posting and due schedule SECAs run, and the posting must complete. The same organization, side, party and document number answers the invoice made before. Raises the run's version. With verifyOnly only checks. Refuses a user without finance administration (and, for a bill, INVOICE_APPROVE), no setup run or an activated one, a side that is not receivable or payable, an unknown, private or internal party, no document number, a date that is not yyyy-MM-dd, a document after the opening day, a currency other than the base currency (single currency until base-currency posting), an amount that is not positive or finer than the currency, and a document imported before with another amount or due date.

return.message: SETUP_RUN_REQUIRED: Save the setup basis before importing open items
SETUP_ACTIVATED: Accounting is activated; open items are not imported now
DIRECTION_INVALID: Give the side as receivable or payable
PERMISSION_DENIED: Importing open bills needs invoice approval (INVOICE_APPROVE)
PARTY_UNAVAILABLE: Counterparty is not available
PARTY_INTERNAL: Open items between internal organizations are not imported
DOCUMENT_NUMBER_REQUIRED: Give the document number
DATE_INVALID: Give the ${dateName} as yyyy-MM-dd
DOCUMENT_AFTER_OPENING: The document is dated after the opening day ${openingDay}

set.from: 'CURRENCY_NOT_BASE: Single currency until base-currency posting: the open item ' + 'must be in ' + baseCurrencyUomId
'OPEN_ITEM_CONFLICT: Document ' + documentNumber + ' was imported as invoice ' + imported.invoiceId + ' with another amount or due date'

service.description: Whether the organization's accounting can be activated, as rows each with its state (ready, check or blocks activation), message and the items it names: preferences, chart, the open periods of the opening day, the posting guard, the migration clearing, receivable and payable accounts, mappings to summary accounts and mapped accounts not in the chart, the inventory WIP and transfer accounts and costing basis, single currency until base-currency posting (open documents and active prices), the sales tax method, bank accounts, the paused past due email job, balanced opening balances and the open items' tie-out. One check that fails is named and the others go on. Refuses a user without finance administration.

Activate the organization's accounting once: post the reviewed version of its opening balances on the opening day (AttOpeningBalance; a receivable or payable control account's balance, which the open items carry, against the migration clearing account, which then nets to zero) and mark the run activated. The same operationKey answers the first result; an activated run answers its posting and posts nothing again. Refuses a user without finance administration, no run, a runVersion that is not the run's, a readiness blocker, and a posting the guard refuses.

return.message: SETUP_RUN_REQUIRED: Save the setup basis first
STALE_REVISION: The setup changed since it was reviewed; review it again
SETUP_NOT_READY: ${refusal}
